title: Missing Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy response header
description: The response omits Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, so the browser default of unsafe-none applies and a cross-origin window that opens this one, or that this one opens, keeps a live WindowProxy reference to it. COOP is the only header that severs that relationship; its absence leaves cross-window navigation and timing observations in place.
remediation: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin on pages that do not need popup round-trips, or same-origin-allow-popups where a popup must keep a relationship. Test the OAuth and payment popups before enforcing it site-wide.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot show whether an opener relationship actually exists, and it does not see the popups a page opens.
